prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Story Scroll Layout Redesign: Redesign the pet selection screen with a vertical story scroll layout that displays pet traits and animated previews.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "story_scroll"}}
1: [choose_path, new_screen] Welcome Story Companion Choice Screen: Insert a new story intro screen immediately after the story screen to set companion expectations before path selection.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "new_story_intro", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_story_intro": {"headline": "Meet Your Virtual Desktop Companion", "body": "Your pet will live right on your desktop. Choose how you want to create your companion today.", "layout": "centered"}}
2: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder Sign-In After Pet Pick Screen: Move the sign-in step to occur right after selecting a pet from the pick friend screen.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "sign_in", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
3: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Interactive Companion Audio Onboarding Flow: Introduce an interactive sound component on the final intro screen allowing users to trigger test audio clips of their pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"components": [{"type": "sound", "label": "Test Pet Voice Audio", "asset": "asset:pet_welcome_audio", "style": "playful", "action": "play"}]}}
4: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Interactive Animation Progress Display: Add an animated progress element and step counter component during the pet generation wait screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_step_counter": true, "components": [{"type": "animation", "asset": "asset:pet_hatching_anim", "style": "playful"}]}}
5: [adoption, layout] Upload Photos Two Column Layout Redesign: Change the upload photos screen layout to a two-column view separating photo submission from formatting tips.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"layout": "two_column"}}
6: [choose_path, copy] Story Screen Quick Setup Welcome Copy: Update story screen headline and body text to highlight the fast and simple 2-minute setup process.
   config: {"story": {"headline": "Adopt Your Desktop Pet in 2 Minutes", "body": "Pick a companion, customize its appearance, and bring it to life on your desktop."}}
7: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Account Sync Helper Text Hint: Add a text component hint clarifying that signing in backs up the pet profile across app restarts.
   config: {"sign_in": {"components": [{"type": "text", "text": "Signing in connects your pet to your account so progress is saved securely.", "style": "subtle"}]}}
8: [finish, incentive] Home Intro Companion Bonus Skin Incentive: Add a prominent badge component on the home intro screen showcasing an unlocked bonus pet skin.
   config: {"home_intro": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Unlocked: Bonus Desktop Companion Outfit", "style": "highlight"}]}}
9: [adoption, notification] Photo Upload Instant Processing Confirmation Notification: Add a badge component on the photo upload screen confirming instant automatic image processing.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Automatic Quality Verification Active", "style": "calm"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigning the pick friend screen layout inside onboarding is allowed.
Adding a new story intro screen inside onboarding is allowed.
Reordering sign-in within onboarding is explicitly permitted.
Adding an interactive sound component to home_intro is allowed inside onboarding.
Adding animation and step progress during the real pet creation wait is allowed.
Changing the layout of the upload photos screen is allowed.
Updating copy on the story screen inside onboarding is allowed.
Adding helpful account sync text to sign-in is allowed.
Onboarding copy mentions bonus items, violating the rule against mentioning free extras or gifts.
Adding a verification status badge to photo upload is allowed.
